events.title: Reserve In Advance: Badminton All Ages
events.description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is available for this activity, check-in prior to activity start time to avoid losing your reservation.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. No waitlist.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.
